dashboard.welcome: Welcome to PantryButler! Let me show you around the dashboard.
dashboard.quickStats: Here you can see quick stats about your pantry, including total ingredients, low stock items, and expiring items.
dashboard.recentRecipes: View your recently added or viewed recipes for quick access.
dashboard.quickActions: Use these quick action buttons to add ingredients, create recipes, or plan meals.

recipes.welcome: Welcome to PantryButler! Let me show you around the app and the recipe collection.
recipes.navRecipes: This is the Recipes section where you can manage your recipe collection.
recipes.navGrocery: Use the Grocery List to plan shopping trips and track what you need to buy.
recipes.navCalendar: The Calendar helps you plan meals for the week.
recipes.navPantry: Manage your pantry ingredients and kitchen equipment here.
recipes.notifications: Check notifications for updates, recipe shares, and announcements.
recipes.userMenu: Access your profile and settings from the user menu.
recipes.addRecipe: Click here to add a new recipe to your collection.
recipes.searchRecipes: Search for recipes by name or ingredients.
recipes.filterFolder: Organize your recipes into folders and filter by folder.
recipes.filterTags: Filter recipes by tags like "vegetarian", "quick", or custom tags you create.
recipes.recipeCard: Click on any recipe card to view details, start cooking, or edit the recipe.

ingredients.welcome: Welcome to your pantry! This is where you manage all your ingredients.
ingredients.addIngredient: Click here to add a new ingredient to your pantry.
ingredients.filterLocation: Filter ingredients by their storage location (Pantry, Refrigerator, Freezer, etc.).
ingredients.ingredientRow: Each ingredient shows its name, quantity, unit, and location. Click to view details.
ingredients.ingredientActions: Use the actions menu to edit, delete, or adjust ingredient quantities.

equipment.welcome: This is your equipment inventory. Track all your kitchen tools and appliances here.
equipment.addEquipment: Click here to add new kitchen equipment.
equipment.equipmentLocation: Change the storage location for each piece of equipment using this dropdown.

groceryList.welcome: Your grocery list helps you plan shopping trips and track what you need to buy.
groceryList.addItem: Add items to your grocery list manually.
groceryList.addFromRecipe: Add missing ingredients from a recipe directly to your grocery list.
groceryList.checkItem: Check off items as you shop. Checked items can be moved to your pantry.
groceryList.moveToPantry: Move checked items to your pantry inventory when you get home from shopping.

mealPlan.welcome: Plan your meals for the week and stay organized!
mealPlan.calendarView: View your meal plan in a weekly calendar format.
mealPlan.addMeal: Click on any meal slot to add a recipe from your collection.
mealPlan.markCooked: Mark meals as cooked to track what you've prepared and update your pantry inventory.

settings.welcome: Customize your PantryButler experience with these settings.
settings.unitSystem: Choose your preferred unit system (metric or imperial) for ingredient measurements.
settings.theme: Switch between light and dark mode to match your preference.
settings.language: Change the app language to your preferred option.
settings.nutrition: Enable nutrition tracking to see nutritional information for your recipes.
settings.exportData: Export all your recipes and data for backup or migration.

recipeDetail.welcome: Welcome to cooking mode! Let me show you the features to help you cook.
recipeDetail.ingredients: View all ingredients needed for this recipe. Check them off as you use them.
recipeDetail.timer: Set timers for cooking steps by clicking the timer button next to time-sensitive instructions.
recipeDetail.steps: Follow step-by-step instructions. Swipe or click to navigate between steps.
recipeDetail.scale: Adjust serving size to automatically scale all ingredient quantities.
recipeDetail.notes: Add personal notes or modifications to remember for next time.

kitchenPantry.welcome: Visualize your kitchen layout and organize your ingredients by location!
kitchenPantry.addLocation: Create custom storage locations that match your actual kitchen layout.
kitchenPantry.dragDrop: Drag and drop ingredients to organize them by location.
kitchenPantry.visualView: See all your ingredients organized by where they're stored in your kitchen.
kitchenPantry.quickAccess: Quickly find ingredients by clicking on a location to see what's stored there.
